title: 938 hardwood flat-cutter feed coupon
note: Four cells down the 36 × 100 top face of a hardwood stick (Y 20 / 36 / 52 / 68), 9 mm text, 1.0 mm deep, on flat-1.0 — the cutter the app recommends for text on this stick (read from the k3 house export) and the cell size the face allows. The ladder brackets the row a 1 mm cutter actually resolves to — the SEEDED hardwood 0.8–1.6 row, S12000 / F400 — with 250 below it and 700 / 1000 above, so the row’s own F400 is cut and the sweep has a value either side of it. That value is what the readback adopts, which is what makes the row measured. The row measures FEED: every other parameter comes from the feeds row unchanged. A 2 mm flat needs ≥13 mm cells and cannot post on the 36 mm face, so it keeps its seeded row.
